text:
maya.lopes: Hi team, happy to be here! Unboxed my MacBook Air (M2) - asset RWI-1210 - and hitting an odd issue during setup: MDM enrollment fails with 'Profile install failed (network_error 403)'. FileVault never triggered. I'm on my apartment Wi-Fi (ISP captive portal maybe). Anyone seen this pattern?
it-support: Welcome Maya 44b Usually a 403 during setup points to the device not reaching our MDM endpoint properly. Two common causes: captive portal / firewall blocking callbacks, or date/time skew preventing TLS. Can you check if you saw a browser auth page during Wi-Fi connect?
maya.lopes: Yes there was a captive portal web page asking me to accept terms before internet. I clicked it earlier but maybe the Setup Assistant didn't complete the login step. How do I check without wiping?
linna-ops: small correction: it's Lina-ops. Also we can try a simpler path: use your phone hotspot for the setup flow (hotspot bypasses captive portals) and retry enrollment. If you prefer to keep current network, ensure the captive portal fully finishes (open Safari from Setup Assistant when prompted).
sam: tagging inventory - serial C02B2ZZZZZ for RWI-1210. If you need us to reissue a zero-touch token after network fix, say the word.
it-support: Step checklist: 1) reboot to continue Setup Assistant if you're still mid-setup, 2) connect to a non-captive network (phone hotspot recommended), 3) when prompted for "Corporate device enrollment requested" accept and complete Okta SSO, 4) if profiles still show errors run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output.
maya.lopes: Ok trying hotspot now. Rebooting.
(5 minutes)
maya.lopes: Connected to phone hotspot, got the "Corporate device enrollment requested" banner, clicked Accept and completed Okta SSO. Running `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` -> `Enrolled via MDM (mdm.redwood.internal)`.
it-support: Great! Kicking FileVault enable policy now. You'll get a modal to enable FileVault and choose escrow to our KMS. Let us know which option you pick.
maya.lopes: Modal appeared. Chose escrow to KMS and set my password. `sudo fdesetup status` -> `FileVault is On`. Thanks!
linna-ops: Logged asset as assigned to maya.lopes. Applied developer role/profile and allowed list for Homebrew and VS Code.
sam: also added an optional note that if you ever need Docker Desktop for local work, request a temporary sudo or we can push the signed PKG.
maya.lopes: I might need Docker next week. For now, Homebrew + VS Code installed fine. Huge thanks for the fast help 60a
mdm-bot: Notice: Profile install and FileVault escrow completed for asset RWI-1210 at 2026-08-04T09:22:18Z.
maya.lopes: Closing thread 495"
